title: [7/1/2023] The number of overseas visitors
prompt: The graph below shows the number of overseas visitors to three different areas in a European country between 1987 and 2007. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting this main features and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The line graph illustrates the number of overseas tourists visiting three different areas, namely the Coast, Mountains and Lakes regions over a 20-year period from 1987 to 2007.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, there was an upward trend in the number of visitors to all three destinations during the period shown. It is also notable that the Lakes area experienced the most significant fluctuations, reaching its peak in 2002.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Looking at the Lakes region first, it started with the lowest figure of around 10,000 sightseers in 1987, before rising steadily to 20,000 by 1992. This upward trend continued more rapidly, reaching 40,000 in 1997 and peaking at about 75,000 visitors in 2002. However, the numbers then declined dramatically to approximately 50,000 by the end of the period.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: Regarding the other two areas, the Coast began with the highest number of visitors at 40,000 in 1987, double the figure for Mountains, at 20,000. The Coast then experienced a slight decrease to 35,000 in 1992. From then onwards, there was a consistent increase to around 45,000 in 1997, followed by further growth to about 62,000 in 2002, ending at roughly 70,000 visitors in 2007. Meanwhile, the Mountains region showed the most stable trend, maintaining this level until 1992, before increasing gradually to 30,000 in 1997 and remaining relatively unchanged until a final slight rise to 35,000 in 2007.
